channel.title: Kim Wilde at the BBC
channel.desc: A look back into the BBC music archives for the best of Kim Wilde's appearances on a range of shows, including classic performances of such hits as `Water on Glass' and `Rage to Love'.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Top of the Pops
channel.desc: A bumper crop of hits from the TOTP archive showcasing an exciting year on the pop charts. 1981 embraced disco and ska, new wave punk, the burgeoning New Romantic scene and the rise of synthpop, with some prog quirkiness and good old rock `n' roll thrown in. Performances from big-hitter soloists Phil Collins, Shakin' Stevens and Kim Wilde are featured alongside the exuberant chaos of groups like Tenpole Tudor, Adam and the Ants and the Teardrop Explodes.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Top of the Pops
channel.desc: The year the teens take over and 80s `new pop' is born with Depeche Mode, the teen-fronted Human League, Kim Wilde and Duran Duran all debuting, while Ultravox and Visage master the art of pop videos. The show embraces the shift with a new theme tune and titles and, as Legs and Co leave, invite a swathe of club kids and cheerleaders in to create a permanent 80s party atmosphere.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Top of the Pops
channel.desc: The treasure troves of the BBC archives are open, so expect smoke machines, shoulder pads and perms along with studio performances from Bon Jovi, Cyndi Lauper, Cameo, The Pretenders, The Real Thing, Billy Ocean, and The Communards.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Top of the Pops
channel.desc: How did the decline of the young guns of the early 80s, the advent of house, the big bang in the money markets and political fatigue on the Left make their mark, or not, on the nation's most popular music show? Paul Heaton, Mick Hucknall, Sinitta, The Communards and Swing Out Sister are among the acts that steer us through the changes impacting Britain, the music industry and the BBC's long-serving pop powerhouse in 1986.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Weatherman Walking
channel.desc: Derek is island hopping in this round-up of his favourite Welsh island walks. He goes wild in west Wales as he sails to Skomer Island - a national nature reserve of international importance due to its seabirds - where he gets a close-up view of the puffins, razorbills and guillemots before staying up late to see the Manx shearwater. Next, Derek goes to Flat Holm Island where he braves a huge colony of seagulls and discovers more about the island's past, including some Victorian gun placements.

channel.title: Landward

channel.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
channel.desc: Ollie Dabbous takes pumpkin soup to a whole new level. Alison Roman whips up a fuss-free one-pot roast chicken. Matt has a perfect Christmas pudding recipe. Emily Scott has a meringue roulade rolled with fresh clementine curd.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Nadiya's British Food Adventure
channel.desc: In Wales, Nadiya finds out what makes Welsh lamb so good and she visits Britain's only homegrown rosewater makers. Back in her own kitchen, Nadiya celebrates the best of Welsh seafood with deep-fried mussels.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: The Great Food Guys
channel.desc: Nick Nairn and Dougie Vipond focus on street food, making falafel with beetroot houmous and Greek salad. Joining them in the kitchen are street food chef Rachna Dheer, from the Babu Bombay Street Kitchen in Glasgow, and `Call the Midwife' actress Laura Main, who selects a Scottish gin to accompany the food.

channel.title: Fiddler on the Roof
channel.desc: Oscar-winning adaptation of the Broadway musical about life among the Jewish community of a pre-revolutionary Russian village. A poor milkman, determined to find good husbands for his five daughters, consults the traditional matchmaker - and also has a word with God.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: Paul Martin presents from Sheffield, where experts Thomas Plant and James Lewis have their work cut out for them with hundreds of people bringing their items along to be inspected and valued. Thomas is interested in a set of watercolours of industrial Sheffield, and James finds a Victorian automaton.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Beaches
channel.desc: Tearjerker about the friendship between two women - a streetwise New Yorker and a blue-blooded San Franciscan - who first met in childhood on the beach in Atlantic City.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for Spain
channel.desc: After making Marbella her home, Eva Longoria celebrates with family and friends, enjoying the city's vibrant dishes and local flavours.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Top Gear
channel.desc: Jeremy Clarkson and Richard Hammond tackle the twin problems of an ageing population and the increasing complexity of modern cars. Meanwhile, James May assesses the new Range Rover around London and then shifts to Nevada for the ultimate challenge against an autonomous military machine.
